decisions.reason: As a multi-model formwork profile system tightly linked to our core engineering and modular know-how, and having already survived the early selection phase, it is more likely to be refined and integrated further than withdrawn.

Magnetic formwork strips are strongly complementary to our established systems and service business, so our existing knowledge base and customer feedback make continued commercialization more attractive than exit.
This magnetic formwork component remains close to our core formwork architecture, and with our in-house R&D and industry growth we are well placed to improve it rather than discontinue it.

Although this magnetic formwork component had weaker product prominence than the others, it still builds on capabilities we already possess, so we would keep it unless demand or overlap with adjacent components clearly deteriorates.
